business_problem: Bridge A.I. needed an affordable cloud-backed system for special education therapy that could collect multimodal student data, analyze it in near real time, and scale from central sites to schools, NGOs, medical groups, and hospitals without driving up storage and access costs.
solution_summary: Bridge A.I. built an AI-assisted special-education platform on Alibaba Cloud to connect students, parents, teachers, and therapists around shared performance data. In each service location, tablets capture student performance and session video, wristbands collect physiological signals for emotion analysis, and environmental sensors contribute context such as temperature and CO2. Those streams move through fog nodes and an edge gateway into Alibaba Cloud, where a platform layer curates SEN educational big data and an application layer turns it into contextual recommendations for trainers and dynamically recommended content for learners. Alibaba Cloud Networking and Edge Node Service help the company move data with low latency while separating frequently accessed data from lower-cost backup tiers for later review and training. The design supports local servers at each site for collection and storage, while still giving Bridge A.I. a shared cloud intelligence layer that expands therapy access across schools, NGOs, hospitals, and new overseas deployments.
business_outcome: Bridge A.I. expanded affordable SEN therapy services across Hong Kong and beyond, with 87% of students showing learning progression after using the AI-enhanced system.
